In fact, Damon has no powers at all, and has simply taken advantage of vulnerable people for many years.

The woman comes to Damon for help as she has visions that are haunting her, just like Damon has claimed to have. The woman asks how he managed to control them, but soon finds that Damon is a fake. While Damon calls the police, the woman stabs her own eyes, much to Damon’s horror. Damon isn’t seen again in the rest of Carrie, but he’s one of the most notable appearances in the show, as he’s played by Mark Hamill.

The legendary actor isn’t recognizable right away as he wears prosthetics to play Damon and uses his voice acting skills, but the more you see and hear him, the more familiar he sounds. Flanagan shared with ScreenRant that it was Hamill’s request to be “somewhat unrecognizable” in his cameo appearance in Carrie, and so his request was fulfilled.
Mark Hamill Has Appeared In Several Of Mike Flanagan's Projects

blocks.c: Mark Hamill sits at a desk peering over his glasses while engaged in conversation in a scene from The Life of Chuck.

blocks.x: Mark Hamill’s cameo in Mike Flanagan’s Carrie TV show is one of the show’s best surprises, but it makes sense when looking back at his past links to Flanagan and Stephen King. In 2023, Hamill played Arthur Pym in Flanagan’s TV series The Fall of the House of Usher, his last project with Netflix before moving to Prime Video. A year later, Hamill played Chuck’s grandfather, Albie Krantz, in Flanagan’s The Life of Chuck, the movie adaptation of King’s novella of the same name.

Outside of Flanagan’s works, Hamill has also been part of other Stephen King adaptations. Hamill had an uncredited cameo in Mick Garris’ 1992 adaptation of Sleepwalkers as Sheriff Jenkins, and in 2025, he had a bigger role as the Major in Francis Lawrence’s adaptation of The Long Walk. Mark Hamill has officially become one of Mike Flanagan’s frequent collaborators, and it’s always a delight to see him play different characters thanks to his impressive acting range.

Mark Hamill’s cameo in Mike Flanagan’s Carrie TV show is one of the show’s best surprises, but it makes sense when looking back at his past links to Flanagan and Stephen King. In 2023, Hamill played Arthur Pym in Flanagan’s TV series The Fall of the House of Usher, his last project with Netflix before moving to Prime Video. A year later, Hamill played Chuck’s grandfather, Albie Krantz, in Flanagan’s The Life of Chuck, the movie adaptation of King’s novella of the same name.

Outside of Flanagan’s works, Hamill has also been part of other Stephen King adaptations. Hamill had an uncredited cameo in Mick Garris’ 1992 adaptation of Sleepwalkers as Sheriff Jenkins, and in 2025, he had a bigger role as the Major in Francis Lawrence’s adaptation of The Long Walk. Mark Hamill has officially become one of Mike Flanagan’s frequent collaborators, and it’s always a delight to see him play different characters thanks to his impressive acting range.
